verdict.rationale: Cake's stock options page says board sign-offs and e-signing can be completed with automated flows, and its capital-raise feature includes digital signing. That is direct but thin support for routing board approvals for signature, scoped to option grants and fundraising. Missing for 10: drafting of board consents or resolutions, stockholder approval workflows, archiving approvals against the transactions they authorize, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, board consents and stockholder approvals are drafted, routed for e-signature, and archived against the transactions they authorize

citations.quote: Complete board sign-offs and e-signing in minutes with automated flows.
Raise SAFEs and Convertible Notes on a seamless workflow, manage digital signing, and communicate with your investors, all in one platform.
